_comment: Checks blk-c02-s08: with no plan, the part that fails is not the part that is missing a line.

stem.en: A toy writes a program in three parts with no plan in the window. Part 3 uses `count`, but no earlier part made it. Why does rewriting only part 3 not fix the error?

text.en: The missing line belongs in an earlier part
The runner did not send the error back
Part 3 is too long for one token

explanation.en: The error names part 3, but the gap is in part 1. Nothing in the window asked part 1 to make count, so a new part 3 still uses a name that no part made. A plan in the window says this before any part is written. The line that fails is not always the line that is wrong.
